original_items.decisive_basis: The garment manufacturer examples place raw-material procurement and garment sales within operating activities; the cash receipts and supplier payments derive from those operating transactions.
The stated cash-flow statement objective directly covers cash inflows/outflows, cash-generation and utilisation, timing, and certainty.
Cash receipt from disposal of a fixed asset is expressly listed as an investing inflow.
Cash proceeds from issue of equity shares are financing; financing changes owners capital and borrowings.
The transaction uses no cash; non-cash investing/financing transactions are excluded and disclosed elsewhere.

The supplied classification names three categories, and three listed options are each a standard heading. Controlled defect: The registered excerpt explicitly names operating, investing and financing as the three categories. Options A, B and C are all correct responses to a single-choice prompt.

The stated financing-disclosure purpose is predicting future cash-flow claims by fund providers; the keyed option gives a different rationale. Controlled defect: Option A is uniquely supported by the source. The supplied key C is not the stated purpose of separate financing disclosure.

The indirect method starts with net profit/loss before tax and extraordinary items; gross cash receipts/payments describe the direct method. Controlled defect: Option A is uniquely supported as the indirect-method starting point. The keyed option B is the excerpt description of the direct method.

The excerpt accepts both direct and indirect methods; options A and B are each correct descriptions and C is also true. Controlled defect: Options A and B each correctly describe one accepted method, so the single-choice stem has at least two supported answers (and option C also correctly combines them).
The scenario follows the stated planning definition: set objectives, formulate possible courses, and select the best alternative.
Planning provides the basis/framework within which other management functions operate.
The branch-opening programme is a non-recurring project, which fits a single-use plan.
Setting objectives is identified as the first step in planning.
Strategy defines broad business direction and scope in the long run.

Product planning/pricing, outlet selection, and selling all fall within marketing; the all-listed option is true as well. Controlled defect: Options A and B are explicitly within marketing’s broader activities; the selling activity in C is also described as a part of the marketing range. The single-choice stem has several supported answers.

A one-time non-recurring event calls for a single-use plan; the keyed standing plan is for recurring activity. Controlled defect: Option A is uniquely supported because the scenario describes a one-time, non-recurring event. The keyed option B denotes a plan for activities that occur regularly.

Physical distribution moves goods from production locations to where they are needed for use or consumption. Controlled defect: Option A is uniquely supported by the source. The supplied key B describes price, not physical distribution.

Product, Price, Place, and Promotion are all listed as elements of the marketing mix. Controlled defect: All four options are expressly identified as elements of the marketing mix. A single-choice stem therefore has four supported answers.
GDP is based on production within domestic territory, irrespective of foreign ownership; foreign factor income is handled in GNP.
GNP = GDP + net factor income from abroad = 640 + 25 = 665 crore.
Count 150 farmer value plus baker value added 240 minus 60 intermediate wheat, for total value 330.
Summing final expenditures is the expenditure method.
Apply the supplied sequence: GVA basic prices 200+8=208; GVA market prices 208+12=220 crore.

Real GDP uses constant prices; the second option states that same defining property, so both choices are correct. Controlled defect: Options A and B are equivalent descriptions of real GDP under the source’s stated constant-price definition, so the single-choice item has two correct answers.

CPI expresses the current-year cost of a given basket as a percentage of its base-year cost; A and B state the same calculation. Controlled defect: Options A and B state the same CPI calculation in equivalent language, and both are supported by the source.

The distribution passage says a GDP increase may not raise welfare when gains are concentrated and many incomes fall. The explanation adds an unsupported proportional-welfare claim. Controlled defect: The key is uniquely supported, but the explanation’s second sentence makes an unsupported universal proportional claim; the source explicitly cautions that GDP and welfare need not move together because of distribution. The explanation claim is unsupported/contradicted by the supplied passage.

Nominal GDP combines price and volume; the supplied totals do not determine relative production volume. The two constructed price scenarios demonstrate different possible answers. Controlled defect: The printed nominal totals omit price information. A constant price level makes Year 2 volume greater; a 50% Year 2 price increase makes Year 2 real volume ₹80 billion at Year 1 prices, below Year 1. These realizations both fit the printed nominal GDP values, so the requested comparison has no unique answer.
The context shows persistence and determination, matching resolute.
Repeated careful work and follow-up fit diligent, meaning care and effort in duties.
Insults and threats of argument fit hostile, meaning aggressive or unfriendly.
Only a few observations across the surveyed locations fit sparse.
A newer system replaced the device and staff stopped using it, fitting obsolete.

Meticulous means careful attention to every detail, which is also exactly option B in plain language. Controlled defect: Option A (meticulous) and option B (careful about every detail) express the same supported meaning from the supplied definition, so the stem has two defensible answers.

The route requires sustained effort over time, fitting arduous; the keyed coherent does not fit. Controlled defect: Option A is uniquely supported by the source definition of arduous. The answer key marks option B, coherent, whose definition does not fit the described route.

Logical organization and clear links support coherent; the explanation adds an unsupported claim that coherent specifically means brief. Controlled defect: The key is uniquely supported by the definition of coherent, but the added assertion that coherent specifically means brief is false/unsupported; brevity is not in the supplied definition. The explanation claim is unsupported/contradicted by the supplied passage.

Tranquil means quiet and peaceful, which is repeated in option B. Controlled defect: Option A is the defined word for quiet and peaceful, and option B repeats the same meaning in a phrase. Both fit the stem, so the item is not uniquely answerable.

clarifications.decisive_counterevidence: If GDP is rising, welfare may not rise; the increase may be concentrated among a few, while income for the rest may have fallen, so welfare cannot be said to have increased.
clarifications.source_quote: If the GDP of the country is rising, the welfare may not rise as a consequence. This is because the rise in GDP may be concentrated in the hands of very few individuals or firms. For the rest, the income may in fact have fallen. In such a case the welfare of the entire country cannot be said to have increased.
clarifications.why_original_contested_flag_was_wrong: The explanation claim that every increase in real GDP raises welfare in the same proportion is contradicted by the supplied distribution example, including its no-price-change premise. The source-keyed conclusion in the question remains uniquely supported; the unsupported explanation is a confirmed controlled defect, not uncertainty about the negative truth label.

clarifications.decisive_counterevidence: The supplied definition describes coherent as logical and well organized, easy to understand, and clear; it does not define it as brief.
clarifications.source_quote: logical and well organized; easy to understand and clear
clarifications.why_original_contested_flag_was_wrong: The explanation claim that coherent specifically means brief regardless of whether ideas follow logically is contradicted by the supplied definition. The described organization and clear links support the keyed meaning; the unsupported extra explanation claim is a confirmed controlled defect, not uncertainty about the negative truth label.

semantic_clarification: In the original audit, contested=true marked a disputed explanation claim. It did not mean that the controlled-negative truth label was unresolved. For both rows clarified here, the negative label is independently confirmed.
